purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official city registration-center evidence confirms local registration and cadastral-survey functions, but no public safe feature schema or anonymous parcel geometry was verified. No city-specific anonymous parcel-vector service and safe feature schema were identified; no geometry query was made.
registryAssessment: The Qingyuan Municipal Real Estate Registration Center budget identifies the center as responsible for land/property registration, cadastral and ownership surveys, archives, and registration information services for Qingcheng and Qingxin districts. This is city-specific registry evidence, but it does not establish an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint or coverage at this WUP point.
